decisions.statement: An operational error may carry the run on another host that raised it.
That run is what the host printed before it stopped, and the exit it stopped on.
Carrying a run changes no code, the error being the one it already was.
An error raised by no run on another host carries no run.
An error this module did not classify exits seventy.
A command exits with a code this module states.
A command wanting another exit declares its own at four or above.
A code this module states is never given a second meaning.
The catch above every command answers seventy.

definition: the code a command exits with, and the error types that have one
